title: More reliable image prompt translation
summary:
Image prompt translation got a reliability fix, two community projects joined the lists, and speech-to-text docs got more precise.

Image prompt enhancement was updated to reduce rate-limit interruptions that could leave Chinese and other non-English prompts poorly translated. Special Bee guidance was also revised to direct most applicants toward seed-tier access.

The website and README now list LLM7.io, a multimodal platform using Pollinations text generation, and Comeback AI, which uses Pollinations audio tools to turn comments into spoken comebacks.

Python and JavaScript examples now say that speech-to-text supports MP3 and WAV, rather than suggesting additional audio formats work.
